preconditions.description: The number of packets must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each packet must contain between 1 and 1000 balloons.
The length of the list of balloon counts must match the number of packets.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if n == 1 or sum(a) % 2 == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If there is only one packet or the total number of balloons is even, output -1.
Both Grigory and Andrew must receive at least one packet.

postconditions.expression: sum(a[i-1] for i in grigory_packets) != sum(a[i-1] for i in andrew_packets)
postconditions.description: The total number of balloons for Grigory must not equal that for Andrew.
